turn_text: Snapshots brought to you by We the People. My name is Will Hart. The CIA is the collectors of last resort. So if the president can't get a piece of information any other way, he goes to the CIA. So our job was in the business of getting human intelligence and espionage. I got to play basketball with Kings and live in an abandoned building for a month in the Hindu Kush Mountains. So it was an awesome opportunity in my country. So I was an undercover guy. So that meant I was a dude in the back alleys. at four o'clock in the morning, chasing terrorists, collecting intelligence on threats to the homeland. And then living in an environment when you're under surveillance is difficult. Your house may be bub, you're being followed all the time. The trade craft that you learn operating in the Cold War is still used. The difference now when you're going after a counterterrorism target is if a terrorist organization gets you, you're gonna get your head cut off. The Russians would probably just beat you up and keep you in a prison for 24 hours. And so the threat to the individual officer is very different when you're prosecuting the global war on terrorism. I was in the CIA when 9-11 happened and I remember the month of August before September of 2001 the feeling and the building that something was going to happen and we didn't understand what or where or how and that people weren't leaving their office they were sleeping in their offices because they were worried that if they went to sleep that something was going to happen and then the first plane flew into the Twin Towers. And I remember that feeling, I remember that feeling of helplessness. I remember that feeling of about being upset, about being angry that they attacked us. And so that's what drove you. That's what allowed you to work the 18 hour days. Put yourself in harm's way because you were doing it for something larger than yourself. You were doing it for those families and friends to make sure nobody ever had to feel that way again. The men and women in the CIA are operating a lot of times on their own in an incredibly dangerous environment in order to keep the homeland safe.
